conclusion: The merge boundary is directly supported. Velocity acquired Havasu's FBO assets and specified airport leaseholds through Velocity Havasu Holdings, LLC, while aircraft management and Northstar maintenance remained with the seller. Current first-party evidence shows the KHII operation integrated into the Tallvine-backed Velocity FBO Network, with no later sale or reassignment found through the cutoff.
